text: December 20, 2024 - Mlabri is a language spoken by the Mlabri people in the border area between Thailand and Laos. text: The Mlabri language (also known as Yumbri or, derogatorily, Phi Tong Luang) is an endangered Khmuic language belonging to the Austroasiatic family, spoken by the indigenous Mlabri people—a traditionally nomadic hunter-gatherer group—in the northern highlands along the Thailand-Laos border.
